{{Quote|SIS &#61; discovered assassination plot // Muun ambassador &#61; target of GenoHaradan // T7 &#61; sent undercover to protect ambassador|T7-O1|<ref name="The Assassination" />}}
A [[Muun/Legends|Muun]] served as an '''ambassador''' during the [[Great Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].<ref name="The Assassination" /> Around [[3663 BBY]],<ref name="Time">{{TOR_dates|1}} Adding twenty years to the date of 3643 BBY gives a resultant date of 3663 BBY.</ref> the [[Ambassador/Legends|ambassador]] was targeted by the [[GenoHaradan]], a secret society of [[Assassin/Legends|assassins]], and the [[Republic Strategic Information Service]]&mdash;the Republic's intelligence agency&mdash;was unable to effectively protect the official because they were compromised. As a result, the SIS enlisted the aid of the [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] [[T7-O1]], the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] partner of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Ven Zallow]], and the droid was assigned to protect the ambassador. Upon detecting the [[Unidentified GenoHaradan assassin|GenoHaradan assassin]] in a crowd, T7-O1 discharged a [[Stun/Legends|stun]] bolt that caused the assassin to flee, and the Muun official decided to resign from his post for fear of further attempts. [[3643 BBY|Twenty]] [[Standard year/Legends|years]] later, T7-O1 investigated the man's fate and learned that the former ambassador lived a long and healthy life thanks to the droid's efforts.<ref name="The Assassination" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Muun ambassador was first mentioned in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[BioWare]] and [[LucasArts]] in [[2011]], during the conversation "The Assassination" with the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] class companion character T7-O1.<ref name="The Assassination" />
